research_notes: Follow up bounded full-time legal practice intervals, breaks, early solicitor/paralegal dates and employers; verify Kemp Strang lead and chambers transitions. Resolve paid sporting contracts and control rather than treating scholarship as public work.

2026-09-29 avenues: current self biography, two surviving chambers PDFs, contemporaneous Lawyers Weekly interview, FIS, ABR history, OWIA 2006/2014 reports, ASADA 2018–19 and AIS archive. APH direct access blocked; frozen official extraction retained. Public professional-profile searches did not produce a directly verifiable CV for earlier firms.

Unverified search-index leads from SignalHire (not accepted as employment evidence): Roper & Steggall 2004–2007, Kemp Strang October 2007–April 2008, Sixth Floor May 2008–September 2014, Garfield Barwick September 2014–January 2016, Family Law Chambers January 2016–May 2019; Ski and Snowboard Association board 2002–2006. Verify with firm/bar archives or legitimately public first-party profile. No contact data retained.

Conflicts retained: athlete 1989 versus 1990 start, initial OWIA term ending 2002 versus 2006, Queenwood 2017 versus 2018 and bar committee 2013 versus 2014. Full-time point observation in 2009 cannot support 11 years. Multiple board and arbitration roles overlap legal practice; no summation. Last follow-up 2026-09-29, unresolved initial record.
